text: Carapaz launched a decisive solo attack on the final climb to Orcières-Merlette, dropping everyone and riding to a commanding victory that underscored EF Education's mountaineering prowess. Schmid and Jorgenson chased hard but couldn't bridge back, both crossing nearly a minute down as the pace shattered the broader GC contenders. Pogaçar held firm through the Alpine gauntlet to extend his lead over Evenepoel, who continues to defend second place methodically while Del Toro consolidated third—with two more mountain stages ahead, the hierarchy feels established but far from settled.
